subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Types of Financial Statement Fraud
description: A quick win: understand Types of Financial Statement Fraud.

hook.text: A company reports $10 billion in revenue. Half of it comes from transactions that never happened.

buildup.text: Financial statement fraud inflates revenue, hides liabilities, or manipulates asset values.

discovery.text: Common techniques include premature revenue recognition and capitalizing ordinary expenses.

twist.text: Statement fraud accounts for just 5% of fraud cases but causes 40% of total losses.

climax.text: One falsified financial statement can wipe out billions in shareholder value overnight.

punchline.text: The rarest fraud causes the most damage.

quiz.question: What percentage of total fraud losses does financial statement fraud cause?
